verdicts.reason: A drops the dark header band, so the white SOLSTICE wordmark nearly disappears on cream. The legal fine print is promoted to body-copy size in its own right column, where it competes with the headline, and the headline is cramped, but the order of eyebrow, headline, body copy and CTA mostly holds. B breaks the reading order: the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow sits at the very bottom, the CTA is jammed into the top-right corner on a dark sliver beside a crushed logo, 'Ships late June' is cut off from its button, and the legal text is as large as the body copy.
